title: From Myth to Message: Trusting God’s Word When Culture Gets Confused
theme: Scriptural context protects believers from cultural speculation and calls them to trust God’s sure word.
proposition: We must read Scripture in its context and trust God’s word above cultural speculation and human imagination.
sermonQuestion: How can we remain faithful to God’s word when culture confuses its meaning?
